GAUTAM AMBLE

Product Owner | Product Manager | Digital Onboarding | Investment Banking & BFSI Bengaluru, India | +91- 9342309830 | gautam_ambale@yahoo.co.in | linkedin.com/in/gautam-amble-8b5bb266 CSPO (Scrum Alliance) | PSPO I (Scrum.org) | Atlassian JIRA Automation | CISI — Investment Operations Certificate

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Product Owner with 8+ years of end-to-end product lifecycle ownership and 14+ years of deep domain expertise in investment banking and financial services. Proven track record of driving digital transformation and product strategy across tier-1 BFSI institutions — including a $4M revenue-generating product initiative at Wells Fargo (FY2025). Expert in translating complex regulatory and business requirements into sprint-ready user stories, acceptance criteria, and epics using Agile / Scrum frameworks. Skilled at backlog management, roadmap ownership, stakeholder management, KPI tracking, UAT, and go-to- market planning. Backed by 6+ years of cross-functional leadership spanning operations, compliance, and technology teams. Proficient in JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, SQL, Power BI, and Miro. CSPO and PSPO I certified.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

$4M Revenue — FY2025 Product Initiative

8+ Yrs Product Owner Experience

6+ Yrs Cross-Functional Leadership

14+ Yrs Investment Banking Domain

CORE COMPETENCIES

Product & Delivery Product Vision & Roadmap Ownership . Agile / Scrum . Backlog Management & Prioritisation . User Stories & Acceptance Criteria . Sprint Planning & Retrospectives . Definition of Done (DoD) & Definition of Ready (DoR) . UAT & Release Management . Go-to-Market Planning . Product Discovery . OKRs & KPI Tracking Domain & Compliance KYC / AML . FINRA Compliance . AIFMD . Regulatory Compliance . Digital Onboarding . Investment Banking Operations . Fund Accounting & NAV . Risk & Controls . Process Re-engineering Tools & Technology JIRA . Confluence . Azure DevOps . SQL . Power BI . Miro . SharePoint . Microsoft Excel (Advanced) . MS Teams . API Integration . User Journey Mapping Leadership & Soft Skills Stakeholder Management . Cross-Functional Collaboration . Voice of Customer (VoC) . MoSCoW Prioritisation . WSJF Framework . Executive Reporting . Conflict Resolution . Team Leadership

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Product Owner (Senior Business Execution Consultant) Wells Fargo EGS India Pvt. Ltd. | Bengaluru

Jun 2020 – Present

Product Highlights

$4M revenue-generating product initiative (FY2025): Owned the full product lifecycle from vision and roadmap through backlog definition, sprint execution, API integration sign-off, and go-live — delivering measurable business value within a regulated BFSI environment.

Digital transformation leadership: Drove end-to-end product strategy for a workflow digitisation initiative; defined epics,

user stories, and acceptance criteria in JIRA, aligned roadmap to OKRs, and facilitated cross-functional discovery workshops using VoC inputs and stakeholder co-creation sessions.

Compliance-by-design: Embedded KYC/AML, FINRA, and regulatory data-flow requirements directly into the product backlog, ensuring zero compliance rework at UAT and release stage — a critical capability for BFSI product delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Led all Agile / Scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives — maintaining cadence, velocity tracking, and Definition of Done (DoD) and Definition of Ready (DoR) standards across multiple concurrent workstreams.

Managed a prioritised product backlog of 100+ user stories applying MoSCoW and WSJF frameworks to maximise business value per sprint; maintained full traceability from epic to story to acceptance criteria.

Acted as single point of accountability for product quality and UAT: planned test scenarios, coordinated UAT cycles, tracked defects in JIRA, and signed off releases against defined KPIs — reducing post-release defect rate significantly.

Partnered with business, technology, UX, and compliance stakeholders to align on product priorities, resolve cross-team dependencies, and maintain delivery velocity without compromising regulatory standards.

Defined and reported product OKRs, KPIs, and sprint metrics to senior stakeholders; used Power BI dashboards and data analysis to make data-informed backlog prioritisation decisions and feed post-release performance insights back into future roadmap planning.

Facilitated product discovery workshops with business, UX, and VoC inputs — mapping customer journeys, validating assumptions, and shaping go-to-market readiness for each release increment.

Collaborated with engineering on API integration user stories and data-flow specifications, applying technical product knowledge to write precise acceptance criteria that eliminated ambiguity during development.

Associate Manager — Digital Onboarding & Fund Operations State Street HCL Services | Bengaluru

Jun 2015 – Jun 2020

Product & Process Leadership

Shaped the end-to-end client onboarding product lifecycle: led KYC/AML journey design, defined SLAs and process

requirements, and drove process re-engineering initiatives that measurably improved SLA adherence for institutional clients.

Designed and delivered KPI dashboards and management reporting (Power BI / Excel) to give leadership real-time visibility into onboarding pipeline health, compliance status, and throughput — a direct precursor to product analytics ownership.

Led a cross-functional team of 6+ spanning operations, compliance, and technology; coordinated stakeholder requirements, managed escalations, and delivered onboarding outcomes within regulated AIFMD fund environments.

Authored detailed process documentation and system enhancement specifications to support technology teams in implementing onboarding workflow improvements with precision and minimal ambiguity.

Conducted exception analysis and root-cause investigation on onboarding breaks; implemented systemic process fixes to drive continuous improvement across the onboarding funnel.

Managed fund accounting operations including NAV calculation, FX validation, and Mark-to-Market valuations for AIFMD- regulated funds, building the regulatory compliance and investment operations expertise that underpins product decision- making at Wells Fargo today.

Operations Analyst — Reconciliation & Reporting JP Morgan Services India Pvt. Ltd. | Bengaluru

Aug 2011 – Jun 2015

Built foundational investment banking expertise across cash and position reconciliation for Pension and Mutual Funds using TLM, Cosmic, Titan, Bloomberg, and Citrix — resolving daily breaks within strict SLA timelines.

Contributed to a reconciliation process improvement initiative that identified systemic breaks across the trade lifecycle, implemented targeted fixes, and measurably reduced exception volumes — an early demonstration of a product and problem-solving mindset.

Managed regulatory reporting and internal audit queries for global investment banking clients, collaborating with onshore and offshore counterparts to ensure accuracy and compliance within SLA timelines.

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) — Scrum Alliance | Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I) — Scrum.org

Atlassian JIRA Automation — Atlassian | Investment Operations Certificate (CISI) — Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment

EDUCATION

PG Diploma — Banking & Finance | SCDL, Symbiosis | BBM — Bachelor of Business Management | Bengaluru University
